72011-nobody-s-rose.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Out in the open country the day was dull and grey, with low-hanging clouds and occasional drops of slow-falling rain, but in the city the clouds of smoke hung still lower than those of the sky, and the dropping soot-flakes made black the moisture gathered on the roofs of the houses, the leaves of the trees, and the sidewalks trodden by many feet.

arxiv-2203-11839.title: Piecewise discretization of monodromy operators of delay equations on adapted meshes
arxiv-2203-11839.creator: Dimitri Breda, Davide Liessi, Rossana Vermiglio
arxiv-2203-11839.description: Abstract Periodic solutions of delay equations are usually approximated as continuous piecewise polynomials on meshes adapted to the solutions’ profile. In practical computations this affects the regularity of the (coefficients of the) linearized system and, in turn, the effectiveness of assessing local stability by approximating the Floquet multipliers.

arxiv-2204-04180.title: Transport coefficients of heavy quarkonia comparing with heavy quark coefficients
arxiv-2204-04180.creator: Juhee Hong, Su Houng Lee
arxiv-2204-04180.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Juhee Hong, Su Houng Lee. We revisit the transport coefficients of heavy quarkonia moving in high-temperature QCD plasmas. The thermal width and mass shift for heavy quarkonia are closely related to the momentum diffusion coefficient and its dispersive counterpart for heavy quarks, respectively. For quarkonium at rest in plasmas the longitudinal gluon part of the color-singlet self-energy diagram is sufficient to determine the leading-order thermal width, whereas the momentum dependence is obtained from the transverse gluon channel.

arxiv-2311-04648.title: Chrono DEM-Engine: A Discrete Element Method dual-GPU simulator with customizable contact forces and element shape
arxiv-2311-04648.creator: Ruochun Zhang, Bonaventura Tagliafierro, Colin Vanden Heuvel, Shlok Sabarwal, Luning Bakke, Yulong Yue, Xin Wei, Radu Serban, Dan Negrut
arxiv-2311-04648.description: Abstract This paper introduces DEM-Engine, a new submodule of Project Chrono, that is designed to carry out Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulations. Based on spherical primitive shapes, DEM-Engine can simulate polydisperse granular materials and handle complex shapes generated as assemblies of primitives, referred to as clumps .

arxiv-2407-03214.title: Measuring cosmic expansion with diffractive gravitational scintillation of nanoHertz gravitational waves
arxiv-2407-03214.creator: Dylan L. Jow, Ue-Li Pen
arxiv-2407-03214.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dylan L. Jow, Ue-Li Pen. The recent discovery of ultra-long wavelength gravitational waves through the advent of pulsar timing arrays (PTA) has opened up new avenues for fundamental science. Here we show that every PTA source will be diffractively lensed by potentially hundreds of galactic disks transverse to its line of sight, leading to modest modulations in the strain, Δ ​ h / h ∼ 10 − 3 ​ λ 1 ​ p ​ c .

arxiv-2502-18625.title: The Market Maker’s Dilemma: Navigating the Fill Probability vs. Post-Fill Returns Trade-Off
arxiv-2502-18625.description: Abstract Using data from a live trading experiment on the Binance Bitcoin perpetual, we examine the effects of (i) basic order book mechanics and (ii) the persistence of price changes from immediate to short timescales, revealing the interplay between returns, queue sizes, and orders’ queue positions.

arxiv-2512-17959.title: Detecting the Unruh Effect via an Engineered Low-Mass Field in a Superconducting Qubit
arxiv-2512-17959.creator: Vladimir Toussaint
arxiv-2512-17959.description: Abstract Detecting the Unruh effect is a major challenge in fundamental physics. It is known that exciting massive fields with the Unruh thermal bath is heavily suppressed when the field’s rest energy is much larger than the acceleration energy scale, M ​ c 2 ≫ ℏ ​ a / c Mc^{2}\gg\hbar a/c .

pmc-10394609.title: Identification of frailty in primary care: accuracy of electronically derived measures
pmc-10394609.creator: Karin MA Swart, Amber AWA van der Heijden, Marieke T Blom, Jetty A Overbeek, Giel Nijpels, Hein PJ van Hout, Petra JM Elders, Ron MC Herings
pmc-10394609.description: BackgroundRoutinely collected clinical data based on electronic medical records could be used to define frailty.AimTo estimate the ability of four potential frailty measures that use electronic medical record data to identify older patients who were frail according to their GP.Design and settingThis retrospective cohort study used data from 36 GP practices in the Dutch PHARMO Data Network.

pmc-10517475.title: The benefits of rehabilitation exercise in improving chronic traumatic encephalopathy: recent advances and future perspectives
pmc-10517475.creator: Yin-qiong Huang, Zhe Wu, Shu Lin, Xiang-rong Chen
pmc-10517475.description: Traumatic encephalopathy syndrome (TES) is used to describe the clinical manifestations of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE). However, effective treatment and prevention strategies are lacking. Increasing evidence has shown that rehabilitation training could prevent cognitive decline, enhance brain plasticity, and effectively improve neurological function in neurodegenerative diseases.

pmc-11356794.title: Update on Obesity and Cardiovascular Risk: From Pathophysiology to Clinical Management
pmc-11356794.creator: Giovanna Gallo, Giovambattista Desideri, Carmine Savoia, Chengwen Sun
pmc-11356794.description: Obesity is an epidemic worldwide. Overweight and multiple obesity-related mechanisms, including dysmetabolic alterations, contribute to cardiovascular deleterious effects. Hence, overweight and obesity have been independently associated with increased cardiovascular risk, whose assessment is crucial for preserving life quality and reducing mortality, and to address appropriate therapeutic strategies in obese patients.

pmc-11359580.title: Decoupled Cross-Modal Transformer for Referring Video Object Segmentation
pmc-11359580.creator: Ao Wu, Rong Wang, Quange Tan, Zhenfeng Song
pmc-11359580.description: Referring video object segmentation (R-VOS) is a fundamental vision-language task which aims to segment the target referred by language expression in all video frames. Existing query-based R-VOS methods have conducted in-depth exploration of the interaction and alignment between visual and linguistic features but fail to transfer the information of the two modalities to the query vector with balanced intensities.

pmc-11525453.title: PrimerX: A Bayesian Multistage Cohort Embedded Randomised Trial to Evaluate the Role of Deferred Local Therapy of the Primary Tumour in Combination with Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor–based First-line Therapy in Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma Patients
pmc-11525453.creator: Orlane Figaroa, Patricia Zondervan, Rob Kessels, Johannes Berkhof, Maureen Aarts, Paul Hamberg, Maartje Los, Djura Piersma, Bart Rikhof, Britt Suelmann, Metin Tascilar, Astrid van der Veldt, Paul Verhagen, Hans Westgeest, Hilin Yildirim, Axel Bex, Adriaan Bins
pmc-11525453.description: Take Home MessageTo reassess the role of deferred cytoreductive nephrectomy in the current era of immunotherapy, we designed PrimerX, a randomised controlled trial following the Trial within Cohorts (TwiCs) study design. Introduction Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) accounts for 3% of adult malignancies and 95% of renal tumours.

pmc-11679255.title: Susceptibility Patterns in Clinical Isolates of Mycobacterium avium Complex from a Hospital in Southern Spain
pmc-11679255.creator: Adrián González Martínez, María Aguilera, María Tarriño, Ana Alberola, Juan Antonio Reguera, Antonio Sampedro, Jose María Navarro, Javier Rodríguez Granger, Maurizio Ciani
pmc-11679255.description: The incidence of infections caused by the Mycobacterium avium complex (MAC) has risen significantly, posing diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. This study analyzed 134 clinical isolates of the Mycobacterium avium complex from southern Spain, performing in vitro antimicrobial susceptibility testing using a commercial microdilution technique to generate additional data, refine treatment strategies, and improve patient outcomes.

pmc-12708664.title: A 25-year assessment of aerosol dynamics and environmental drivers in Iran’s Lakes and wetlands
pmc-12708664.creator: Zohre Ebrahimi-Khusfi, Seyed Arman Samadi-Todar, Narjes Okati, Dimitris G Kaskaoutis
pmc-12708664.description: This paper investigates the spatiotemporal patterns of aerosol optical depth (AOD) over 25 wetlands and lakes in Iran during the period 2000–2024. Monthly AOD values were integrated with climate and terrestrial variables. Trend analysis was performed using the Hamed-Rao Mann-Kendall test and Sen’s slope estimator.

pmc-13113601.title: Prognostic Power of Ensemble Learning in Colorectal Cancer with Peritoneal Metastasis: A Multi-Institutional Analysis
pmc-13113601.creator: Yoshiko Bamba, Michio Itabashi, Hirotoshi Kobayashi, Kenjiro Kotake, Masayasu Kawasaki, Yukihide Kanemitsu, Yusuke Kinugasa, Hideki Ueno, Kotaro Maeda, Takeshi Suto, Kimihiko Funahashi, Heita Ozawa, Fumikazu Koyama, Shingo Noura, Hideyuki Ishida, Masayuki Ohue, Tomomichi Kiyomatsu, Soichiro Ishihara
pmc-13113601.description: Background: Owing to significant clinical heterogeneity, the achievement of accurate survival forecasting for individuals with colorectal cancer and peritoneal metastasis continues to be a complex undertaking. We aimed to transcend traditional prognostic limitations by evaluating machine learning boosting models against standard regression-based methods in terms of estimating overall survival (OS).

pmc-13285881.title: Comparison of urethane dimethacrylate monomer elution between indirect composites when subjecting to thermocycling
pmc-13285881.creator: Nur Amalia Mohd Hanifah, Sherrifah Nur Athirah A-Idid Syed Mohammed Idid, Fatima Ahmed Qaid, Zethy Hanum Binti Mohamed Kassim, Ikmal Hisham Bin Ismail, Lee Wei May
pmc-13285881.description: Context:The use of resin-based computer-aided design and computer-aided manufacturing (CAD/CAM) blocks is increasing in restorative dentistry. However, the potential elution of urethane dimethacrylate (UDMA) into saliva and its associated safety implications remain insufficiently investigated.Aims:To identify and quantify the monomer elution of two different indirect composite blocks before and after thermocycling.Settings and Design:In vitro study.
